newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - January 10.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Members of Bamboo Gang turn themselves in.
Vice-President Lien Chan to meet pope, then visit Belgium.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - President Lee Teng-hui says he will not let Governor James Soong resign.
Prosecutors seek death sentence for Nien Chung-jen, deputy speaker of Changhua country.
LIBERTY TIMES - Taiwan Governor James Soong says he has no desire to return to his post.
Offshore Taiwan stock index futures launched in United States and Singapore.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Industries face hikes in water fees.
Ruling Nationalist Party-owned businesses to lay off employees.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Finance ministry to allow banks to invest in over-the-counter stocks in near term.
Launch of offshore Taiwan stock index futures did not affect stock market.
